about_the_game:
Fight boss after boss in stylish, adrenaline-fueled combat.
This demo offers a first look into Eden Warrior, a dark fantasy action game where precision and timing mean everything.

Face off against powerful corrupted legends using fast-paced, skill-based mechanics. Master the flow of battle with Quick Draws, executions, and the powerful Crown Breaking Technique.

In this demo, you’ll:

  • Experience the first major boss encounter

  • Learn the basics of Eden-powered combat

  • Get a glimpse into the mysterious story of a puppet created to hunt fallen heroes

The full game will feature a series of intense boss battles, minimalistic storytelling, and high replay value for action fans.
